mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS id, a.title AS title, a.content AS content, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.create_time) AS create_time, a.update_time AS update_time, a.view_count AS view_count, MAX(IFNULL(al.like_count, 0)) AS like_count, MAX(IFNULL(c.comment_count, 0)) AS comment_count FROM article a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT article_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM article_like GROUP BY article_id ) al ON al.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT article_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comment GROUP BY article_id ) c ON c.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN category cat ON a.category_id = cat.id WHERE a.status = 0 AND a.del_flag = 0 AND a.id = #{id} GROUP BY a.id;

select a.id as id, a.title as title, a.summary as summary, a.thumbnail as thumbnail, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.create_time) as create_time, a.view_count as view_count, (select count(*) from article_like as al where al.article_id = a.id) as like_count, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name SEPARATOR ',') AS tag_name from article as a left join category as c on a.category_id = c.id left join article_tag as at on a.id = at.article_id left join tag as t on at.tag_id = t.id
a.status = 0 and a.del_flag = 0
and a.category_id = #{req.categoryId}
group by a.id, a.create_time order by a.create_time desc
